resolved_findings.finding: Saved interface locale did not drive authenticated Social UI.
resolved_findings.resolution: A persona-first resolver now applies translated critical navigation and document lang/direction immediately.

resolved_findings.finding: Malformed content-language entries were silently filtered.
resolved_findings.resolution: The API rejects invalid type, cardinality or entries and preserves a normalized unique list.

resolved_findings.finding: Near could be enabled without an explicit region.
resolved_findings.resolution: Strict boolean consent plus effective-state validation rejects contradictory state.

resolved_findings.finding: An enabled Near profile could clear its region.
resolved_findings.resolution: Effective resulting state must retain a valid explicit region or disable Near in the same mutation.

resolved_findings.finding: An empty Near feed could be replaced by unfiltered demo clips.
resolved_findings.resolution: Demo fallback is restricted to the initial mix/For You surface; every other empty lens renders an authentic empty state.

resolved_findings.finding: Breaking-disabled and Near-consent early exits retained previous feed authors for relation suggestions.
resolved_findings.resolution: One fail-closed reset clears posts and visual feed state on API failure, disabled provider, consent-required and empty-feed exits.
